values.content:
=Analyze this coffee shop sales data as a CEO would want to see it. Be concise and actionable.

SALES SUMMARY:
• Total Revenue: ${{ $json.totalRevenue }}
• Total Transactions: {{ $json.totalTransactions }}
• Total Quantity Sold: {{ $json.totalQuantitySold }}
• Average Transaction Value: ${{ $json.averageTransactionValue }}

TOP PERFORMERS:
• Top Store: {{ $json.topStore.name }} (${{ $json.topStore.revenue }})
• Top Category: {{ $json.topCategory.name }} (${{ $json.topCategory.revenue }})
• Top Product: {{ $json.topProduct.name }} (${{ $json.topProduct.revenue }})

LOW PERFORMER:
• Lowest Revenue Product: {{ $json.lowestProduct.name }} (${{ $json.lowestProduct.revenue }})

TIME INSIGHTS:
• Busiest Hour: {{ $json.busiestHour.hour }}:00 (${{ $json.busiestHour.revenue }})

STORE PERFORMANCE:
{{ Object.entries($json.revenueByStore).map(([store, revenue]) => `${store}: $${revenue.toFixed(2)}`).join(', ') }}

CATEGORY PERFORMANCE:
{{ Object.entries($json.revenueByCategory).map(([category, revenue]) => `${category}: $${revenue.toFixed(2)}`).join(', ') }}

Provide a 3-4 sentence executive summary with the most important business insights.

Then provide 2-3 actionable recommendations for management.

Focus on:
- Which store is performing best
- Which product/category is driving revenue
- Which product is underperforming
- Peak sales timing
- Any unusual sales pattern or concentration that management should investigate

parameters.text: =📊 *Coffee Shop Sales Update*  💰 *Revenue:* ${{ $('Calculate KPIs').item.json.totalRevenue }} 🧾 *Total Transactions:* {{ $('Calculate KPIs').item.json.totalTransactions }} 📦 *Quantity Sold:* {{ $('Calculate KPIs').item.json.totalQuantitySold }} 📈 *Avg Transaction Value:* ${{ $('Calculate KPIs').item.json.averageTransactionValue }}  🏆 *Top Performers:* • Top Store: {{ $('Calculate KPIs').item.json.topStore.name }} (${{ $('Calculate KPIs').item.json.topStore.revenue }}) • Top Category: {{ $('Calculate KPIs').item.json.topCategory.name }} (${{ $('Calculate KPIs').item.json.topCategory.revenue }}) • Top Product: {{ $('Calculate KPIs').item.json.topProduct.name }} (${{ $('Calculate KPIs').item.json.topProduct.revenue }})  📉 *Lowest Performing Product:* • {{ $('Calculate KPIs').item.json.lowestProduct.name }} (${{ $('Calculate KPIs').item.json.lowestProduct.revenue }})  ⏰ *Peak Hour:* • {{ $('Calculate KPIs').item.json.busiestHour.hour }}:00 (${{ $('Calculate KPIs').item.json.busiestHour.revenue }})  📍 *Store Performance:* {{ Object.entries($('Calculate KPIs').item.json.revenueByStore).map(([store, revenue]) => '• ' + store + ': $' + revenue.toFixed(2)).join('\n') }}  ☕ *Category Performance:* {{ Object.entries($('Calculate KPIs').item.json.revenueByCategory).map(([category, revenue]) => '• ' + category + ': $' + revenue.toFixed(2)).join('\n') }}  🤖 *AI Insight:* {{ $json.content.parts[0].text }}
